agent.sources: yelp_review supplies business_ref, rating and text date; yelp_business supplies name and description, with categories read out of the free-text description.
agent.keys: Rewrite the review's 'businessref_' prefix to 'businessid_' and match business_id exactly, which amounts to matching on the same number.
agent.parse: Three date shapes picked by regex: ISO datetime, 'DD Mon YYYY, HH24:MI', 'Month DD, YYYY at H:MI AM'. Categories are capitalised phrases after the 'City, ST,' clause.
agent.filter: Keep reviews from 2016-01-01 up to but not including 2016-07-01; HAVING keeps businesses with at least 5 such reviews.
agent.metric: Per business: average rating over reviews in the window.
agent.rank: Order by average rating descending, then business_id text ascending, with no review-count tie-break; keep the top one.
agent.shape: Three columns: name, average rating, and categories joined by ', ', instead of one combined name-and-categories string.

ledger.why: The agent returns the name, the average rating and the categories as three separate columns, but the reference returns a single string with the name followed by its categories and no rating.

golden.rank: Review count from highest to lowest, ties broken alphabetically by category, top 5 kept.
golden.parse: Dates come in three text formats, each matched by regex and parsed with to_timestamp. Categories are the capitalised phrases after the 'City, ST,' clause, joined by space, '&', '/', 'of', with '(X)' qualifiers.
golden.shape: Five rows, one column: the category name. Counts are not shown.
golden.filter: Users whose parsed yelping_since year is 2016. Reviews dated on or after 2016-01-01. Reviews with no user or no matching business drop out of the inner joins.
golden.metric: Counts reviews per category. Each distinct (business, category) pair is counted once, so every review adds 1 to each category of its business.
golden.sources: yelp_user.yelping_since for registration date; yelp_review.date, user_id, business_ref for reviews; yelp_business.description free text holds the categories.
